messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a good wipe‑down, remove dust, and tune it to standard pitch (or the key you prefer). | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and shows you care about its condition. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the body, neck, fretboard, headstock, and any unique features or blemishes. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Great photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of returns. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds. Note prices for similar models, ages, and conditions. | Knowing the market helps you set a realistic price and avoid over‑ or under‑pricing. | | **4. Write a Detailed Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition notes, any repairs, and why you’re selling. Mention accessories (case, strap, picks). | Transparency builds trust and reduces back‑and‑forth questions. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, buyer protection.
• **eBay** – wide reach, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist/Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local Music Stores** – may buy outright or consign.
• **Pawn Shops** – quick cash, but usually lower offers. | Different platforms reach different audiences; use multiple if you want speed. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target to allow room for negotiation. Consider adding “+” to indicate willingness to negotiate. | Buyers often expect some haggling; a higher starting point can still land you a good deal. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Local Pickup** – no shipping costs, instant payment.
• **Shipping** – use a sturdy case, bubble wrap, and trackable service. Offer free shipping if you’re comfortable. | Shipping expands your buyer pool but adds cost and risk; weigh the pros/cons. | | **8. Secure Payment** | • **Cash** – safest for local sales.
• **PayPal / Venmo** – trackable, but watch for fees.
• **Escrow** – Reverb’s built‑in escrow protects both parties. | Avoid scams by using secure, traceable payment methods. | | **9. Handle Negotiations Professionally** | Respond promptly, keep tone friendly, and be prepared to justify your price. | Good communication can close the sale faster and leave a positive impression. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | Once payment is confirmed, ship or hand over the guitar. Keep receipts and tracking numbers. | Documentation protects you in case of disputes. | ### Quick Tips - **Highlight Unique Features**: If your guitar has custom inlays, a special finish, or a rare wood, mention it. These can justify a higher price. - **Offer Extras**: A new strap, case, or a set of picks can sweeten the deal. - **Be Honest About Wear**: Stains, scratches, or a loose string are normal, but disclose them upfront to avoid returns. - **Safety First**: For local pickups, meet in a public place or bring a friend. For shipping, use a reputable carrier and insure the package. ### Example Listing > **Title**: 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition > **Description**: > • Brand: Yamaha > • Model: FG800 > • Year: 2015 > • Condition: Minor scuff on the back, otherwise pristine. > • Accessories: New strap, case, and pick set. > • Reason for selling: Upgrading to a 2020 Gibson. > **Price**: $350 (negotiable) > **Payment**: Cash or PayPal (shipping available). With a clear listing, competitive pricing, and a professional approach, you’ll attract serious buyers and close the sale smoothly. Good luck!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can provide steps: research market value, clean instrument, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention local music stores, pawn shops. Provide tips for negotiation, payment methods. Possibly mention using the tune_instrument function? But that function tunes instrument; not relevant. So no function call. Just answer.
